page.notes: Running head "Cap.3." read as printed. The "Erafm. Annot." note mark is uncertain ("Irafra" in the scan). The large initial is read as "I" joined to "Mò". "ingum" and "Cauédaest" are doubtful. Quotation block: the scan has a quotation mark at the start of each line; only the opening one is kept. The word after "ne-" is doubtful. "Eccle-rum s.Pont." sits below the last line at right; it is read as a catchword but could be a footnote. The "{e}" mark placement is inferred from the note. The "Sect. XIV." note is placed inside the heading because it stands beside the subtitle.
